ambient_events: Sun-warmed teak ticks softly as it expands under the open sky.
The jacuzzi murmurs to itself, a low ring of steam curling off the turquoise water.
A gull rides the wind off the Basin, hangs a moment, and wheels away.
The deck telescope creaks a quarter-turn in the wind and holds its new bearing.
description: The Echelon's topmost terrace, open to the sky on the bridge roof. Pale teak underfoot, a curved run of cushioned loungers and a raised jacuzzi lit turquoise from below. A brass telescope stands at the forward rail, trained over the bow. A companionway goes DOWN to the bridge. You can LOOK EAST or WEST across the water.
name: Echelon — Sun Deck
